Monday Conversation: Will we ever see a real WoW killer?

I think MMORPGs as a genre in general is kind of dying because there is simply no way to make the amount of content it takes to make people play for years at a time cheaply and quickly enough to justify doing it. Every single major MMO that tried ended up costing more than 50-100 million dollars to make and didn't make anywhere near as much money back.

WoW can't update it's graphics, because the second they do that they fall right into the trap of insanely expensive artwork that costs millions of dollars to produce that has killed so many games already. WoW has always spent that money on instead getting more artwork, more quests, more content, rather than making extremely expensive content that can't be produced in large enough quantities.

There are some essential sort of economics of scale that you need to make a WoW sized game with modern graphics that simply don't exist. You need millions of players to pull it off, and there is simply no guarantee you're going to get that kind of a playerbase. In fact it's extremely unlikely.
